observation.visible_scene: A silver ION boombox with a central cassette deck and two round speakers sits stationary on a flat paved boardwalk, with palm trees, lamp posts and low buildings in the background. Two roller-skating people circle around it: one wears ripped light-blue jeans and gold/tan skates with pale-yellow wheels; the other wears pink-camo shorts, black socks and white skates with pink wheels. The camera stays fixed on the boombox, which remains centered and unmoved throughout.
visible_changes: The white-skated skater enters at the right edge and rolls leftward across the front of the boombox, ending on the left side of the frame.
The gold-skated skater starts on the left, moves behind the boombox, then appears on the right, and finally rolls into the front-center of the frame.
The two skaters continuously swap left/right positions relative to the boombox, alternately occluding it and being occluded by it as they pass in front of or behind it.
In the later frames the gold skate tilts upward at an angle (toe pick raised, heel down) as the leg extends, a skating pose rather than a change in the boombox.
The boombox itself shows no translation, rotation or deformation; only its visible surface is intermittently blocked by passing legs and skates.
Background elements (palm trunks, lamp posts, buildings) hold steady positions, indicating the apparent motion is the skaters moving, not the camera panning.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the skaters do before entering and after the last frame is not shown.
Whether the tilted gold skate makes contact with the boombox or merely passes in front is not determinable.
Audio, ownership of the skates, and the broader event context are unseen.
The exact number of people is inferred only from two pairs of legs.
uncertain_details: Small apparent shifts in background framing could be minor camera movement or perspective from the fixed viewpoint; not certain.
Direction and speed of each skater's roll are estimated from frame-to-frame position changes, not from a continuous track.
